g.text: Random folds · neighbourhood holdouts · six spatial-block configurations
Pooled OOF errors on the same frozen city samples under random, primary neighbourhood and six fixed spatial-block configurations. Lines connect
categorical designs, not a continuous treatment. Different holdout geometry changes the prediction task; overlapping training sets and correlated
